analyst_reviews.reason: Martinez's projection sits just above 13.5. The +108 price needs only a little under a coin flip. The case is narrow and rests on a short postseason leash not cutting his recent length.
+165 matches the ten-book consensus, so there is no price premium. All of the value depends on the model rating the Rays near even money, while its own inputs favor Milwaukee.
Misiorowski's recent length (about 13.7 outs) and projection (about 14.4) both sit below the 15.5 line. Even money needs a coin flip. The direction holds unless extra rest leads to a longer outing.
The under rests only on an unverified research lead. The original model projects far more scoring than 6.5, and the price is near even across a broad book set with no visible edge.
The projected strikeout mean sits modestly below 6.5 against a contact-heavy opponent. The case is thin and depends heavily on workload, but no material blocker is identified.
The line is already set at 3.5, which absorbs most of the low-strikeout angle. The projected mean sits above it, and -156 is steeper than the multi-book consensus.

methods: Consensus probabilities remove each book’s margin and pair books quoting the same line.
Recorded totals are the median line in the last briefing snapshot before first pitch, not a verified closing line.
Final scores come from published reporting; Fourth & Value does not store MLB final scores.
limitations: Fixed threshold grids, not archived historical bookmaker lines; no historical ROI claim.
Historical evaluation conditions on actual starters and original batting order; archived pregame announcements are unavailable.
Postseason audit is small and uses an earlier model fitted before that postseason; upcoming playoff accuracy is unproven.
No explicit handedness, weather, injury, umpire or tactical pinch-hit adjustments.
Park estimates are shrunk venue scoring averages and can include home-team effects.
Joint team-run approximation conditions out ties; extra-inning dynamics are not simulated pitch by pitch.
Every Fourth & Value model is experimental and has not been validated against betting prices.
Prices are dated and can change before first pitch; batting orders were not posted at the morning check.
